description: The AppLovin account’s product catalogs and their variant sets: the catalogId and variantSetId a dynamic-ads campaign (create_applovin_ads_campaign) needs. Website accounts. Read-only, free. Needs the Campaign Management key, which exists once AppLovin enables API access on the account; without it the answer says how to get it.
name: list_applovin_ads_catalogs
title: List AppLovin catalogs
